mapper.select:
SELECT sp.ent_ceo_no AS entCeoNo, p.products_no AS productsNo, p.products_nm AS productName, pc.small_category AS cateName, sp.use_status AS productStatus, q.quantity AS quantity, b.brand_nm AS brandName, CASE WHEN q.quantity = 0 THEN '품절' ELSE '사용중' END AS stockStatus FROM sell_products sp JOIN products p ON sp.products_no = p.products_no JOIN products_category pc ON p.product_category_no = pc.product_category_no JOIN quantity q ON sp.products_no = q.products_no JOIN model m ON p.model_no = m.model_no JOIN brand b ON m.brand_no = b.brand_no
AND p.products_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND b.brand_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND p.product_category_no = #{categoryNo}
AND sp.use_status = #{status}
AND q.quantity = 0
AND q.quantity > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sell_products ( sell_products_no, margin_ratio_no, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, products_no, lump_sum_pay_price, period, calculate_price, final_price, register_date, revision_date, use_status ) VALUES ( #{sellProductsNo}, #{marginRatioNum}, #{entCeoNo}, #{entEmpId}, #{productsNo}, #{lumpSumPayPrice}, #{period}, #{calculatePrice}, #{finalPrice}, #{registerDate}, #{revisionDate}, #{useStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.sell_products_no AS sellProductsNo, p.products_nm AS productName, m.model_nm AS modelName, s.lump_sum_pay_price AS lumpSumPayPrice, s.period AS period, s.calculate_price AS calculatePrice, s.final_price AS finalPrice, s.use_status AS useStatus FROM sell_products s LEFT JOIN products p ON s.products_no = p.products_no LEFT JOIN model m ON p.model_no = m.model_no WHERE s.sell_products_no = #{sellProductsNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE sell_products SET lump_sum_pay_price = #{lumpSumPayPrice}, calculate_price = #{calculatePrice}, final_price = #{finalPrice}, revision_date = NOW() WHERE sell_products_no = #{sellProductsNo}
mapper.select: SELECT sp.sell_products_no, sp.ent_ceo_no, sp.ent_emp_id, sp.products_no, sp.lump_sum_pay_price, sp.period, sp.calculate_price, sp.final_price, sp.register_date, sp.revision_date, m.model_nm FROM sell_products sp LEFT JOIN products p ON p.products_no = sp.products_no LEFT JOIN model m ON p.model_no = m.model_no WHERE sp.sell_products_no = #{sellProductsNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE quantity SET quantity = #{quantity}, revision_date = NOW() WHERE products_no = #{productsNo}
